notes.title: Play Hidden Breed Demo for Free on Steam VR!
notes.content:
The wait is over! The Hidden Breed demo is now available for FREE on Steam VR! Step into the boots of Dr. Laura Mendez as she battles terrifying alien creatures and fights for survival in an isolated moon station overrun by the deadly Colloids.

🔥 What to Expect in the Demo:
✅ [b]Intense VR Combat[/b] – Wield powerful weapons against relentless alien threats.
✅ [b] Immersive Sci-Fi Horror[/b] – Explore the eerie corridors of the moon station.
✅ [b]Heart-Pounding Action[/b] – Test your survival instincts in deep space.

As we are still in the demo phase, we would greatly appreciate your feedback and will be making continuous improvements in the coming months. Your insights help shape the game, and we’re committed to making it even better!

An [b]enhanced version[/b] of the [b]demo[/b] featuring [b]new weapons, improved combat, and more alien enemies[/b] will launch during [b]Steam Next Fest (Feb 24 – Mar 3, 2025[/b]).

A huge thank you to everyone who plays the demo, adds the game to their wishlist, and shares their experiences! Your support means the world, and I can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Thank you, 

Harold M
